Container.Name: aquilon-pitch
Container.Overview:
Pitch compensation for an Analog Way LivePremier screen spanning LED walls of different pixel pitches: the H and V ratios to type into Web RCS, the canvas each output group takes, and what the three-decimal field costs at the far edge of each wall. Runs entirely in the browser.
Note: There is no _headers file in this repo, so the image carries the default header set.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface.
